$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKO (AIP France, chart dated 2024-09-05): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Propriano

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD restricted to ACFT whose wingspan is less than 24 m and whose overall width of main landing gear is less than 6 m.
AD limited to ACFT with maximum takeoff weight (MTOW) lower than 5700 kg.
Paramotors: use of AD under prior AD operator agreement.
Presence of mountainous terrain (Castellu di Baresi) in downwind eastern part. traffic circuit integration.
HEL: ARR on RWY axis, clearing by TWY and translation to AVT or AST.
Parachute jumping activity ( NR 413): FL 140, SR-SS + 30.
From 1st JUN to 30th SEP: - SAT and SUN: activity limited to FL 070.
Activity known via AJACCIO APP and AJACCIO INFO.
Paramotor activity known in July and August North of the airfield on Olmeto beach.
